g.title: DILI_QSP
g.text: Drug-Induced Liver Injury (DILI) — QSP Mechanistic Map
약물유발 간손상 · 정량적 시스템 약리학 지도
Reactive-metabolite flux vs. thiol resynthesis · mitochondrial bioenergetics · JNK–Sab bistable amplification ·
bile-acid (BSEP) cholestasis · innate DAMP signalling · HLA-restricted adaptive immunity · regeneration reserve
Central claim: injury = f(production rate / disposal rate), and the system is bistable — so the same AUC can be silent or fatal.
